title: Cosmogenesis
description: False vacuum decay plus inflation equals a new universe. Then harvest it.

puzzle.goal: A scalar field φ sits in a false vacuum of energy V_f and can tunnel to a lower one by nucleating a bubble. In imaginary time the bubble is O(4)-symmetric, so its Euclidean action is an integral over the radius r with the area 2π²r³ of a 3-sphere. Write the action of the bubble relative to the false vacuum.
puzzle.name: Coleman bounce action (thin-wall false vacuum decay)
puzzle.ask: For a thin wall of tension σ and vacuum energy difference ε the action is B(R) = 2π²R³σ − π²R⁴ε/2, extremal at R = 3σ/ε, giving B = 27π²σ⁴/(2ε³). Find B (decay rate ∝ e^(−B)) in natural units.

vars.\u03b5: energy density difference of the two vacua

puzzle.method: Rotate time to imaginary time; the least-action tunnelling path is spherically symmetric in four Euclidean dimensions, so dV₄ = 2π²r³dr and the Lagrangian is kinetic plus potential energy.
